decisions.reason: As a simple accessory tightly linked to the firm’s trailer business and after-sales offering, it fits existing knowledge well, though its small strategic importance makes discontinuation somewhat more plausible than for major trailer lines.
A box car trailer series is very close to the firm’s established manufacturing, sales, and service capabilities, so management is likely to keep refining and marketing it rather than withdraw it.
A car transporter trailer remains within the firm’s core trailer competence, but its more specialized use case raises the risk of withdrawal somewhat if demand proves narrower than expected.
A low-bed trailer series builds directly on the firm’s existing product, production, and service knowledge, which supports learning and continued commercialization.
A high trailer cover series is highly complementary to the firm’s trailer range and can be supported through the same channels, making retention more likely than discontinuation.

This box car trailer series is also closely related to the firm’s existing know-how, although possible overlap with other box trailer offerings creates a somewhat higher chance of portfolio rationalization.
